title: fix: Revert `HTMLDocument` removal
body:
See issue #4792, https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/221 and https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/278

This is already implemented in all major browsers (**Firefox**, **Chrome** and **Safari**).

**WPT** tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/20403, https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/20676

(See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.)
